intended_object: The duality fact/construction that an initial object X of the opposite category Cᵒᵖ yields a terminal object X.unop of C (inferred from docstring and name).
explanation: The lift sends a cone point s.pt to the unop of the unique morphism X ⟶ op s.pt, and uniqueness follows from initiality via injectivity of op on morphisms. This is exactly the standard argument, stated for an arbitrary category C, so the generality is natural. The same construction also exists in the same file as `IsInitial.unop` (built via `IsTerminal.ofUniqueHom`); the two are interchangeable, since IsTerminal structures on a given object form a subsingleton.
